evals.name: rewrite-research-methodology
evals.prompt: Rewrite methodology.md in Simplified Technical English. Keep every technical term of the field intact - I don't want 'census tract' or 'difference-in-differences' turned into something else. Tell me what you changed.
evals.expected_output: methodology rewritten into STE at a new path, a change report grouped by rule with rule numbers cited, domain terminology preserved, and the bundled checker run on the rewrite showing zero violations

evals.name: write-procedure-in-ste
evals.prompt: Write the setup instructions for our data pipeline in STE. Steps: install Python 3.12 and the requirements file, put the raw ACS extracts in data/raw, set the CENSUS_API_KEY environment variable, run build.py, then check the output tables in results/. Warn people that running build.py overwrites anything already in results/.
evals.expected_output: procedural STE: imperative sentences, one instruction each, at most 20 words per sentence, and a correctly structured warning placed before the step it applies to

evals.name: ambiguous-target-must-ask
evals.expected_output: the model asks which document to work on and lists the candidates it can see; it does not rewrite any file
